WITH product_sales_by_store AS (
  SELECT o.STORE_ID,
         p.SKU,
         p.PRODUCT_NAME,
         COUNT(*) AS items_sold,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.STORE_ID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank
  FROM ORDER_ITEMS oi
  JOIN ORDERS o ON oi.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID
  JOIN PRODUCTS p ON oi.SKU = p.SKU
  GROUP BY o.STORE_ID, p.SKU, p.PRODUCT_NAME
)
SELECT s.STORE_NAME,
       pss.PRODUCT_NAME,
       pss.items_sold
FROM product_sales_by_store pss
JOIN STORES s ON pss.STORE_ID = s.STORE_ID
WHERE pss.rank = 1
ORDER BY s.STORE_NAME

       R.ITEMS_SOLD
FROM RANKED R
JOIN STORES S ON R.STORE_ID = S.STORE_ID
JOIN PRODUCTS P ON R.SKU = P.SKU
WHERE R.RN = 1
ORDER BY S.STORE_NAME

WITH counts AS (
  SELECT o.STORE_ID, oi.SKU, COUNT(*) AS items_sold
  FROM ORDER_ITEMS oi
  JOIN ORDERS o ON oi.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID
  GROUP BY o.STORE_ID, oi.SKU
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT counts.*,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY STORE_ID ORDER BY items_sold DESC, SKU) AS rn
  FROM counts
)

FROM ranked

JOIN PRODUCTS p ON ranked.SKU = p.SKU

WITH firsts AS (
  SELECT c.CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID AS person,
         date_trunc('month', MIN(o.ORDER_PURCHASE_TIMESTAMP)) AS cohort_month
  FROM ORDERS o
  JOIN CUSTOMERS c ON o.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID
  GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID
),
person_orders AS (
  SELECT c.CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID AS person, oi.PRICE
  FROM ORDER_ITEMS oi
  JOIN ORDERS o ON oi.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID
  JOIN CUSTOMERS c ON o.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID
  WHERE o.ORDER_STATUS = 'delivered'
)
SELECT f.COHORT_MONTH,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.PERSON) AS COHORT_CUSTOMERS,
       COALESCE(SUM(po.PRICE), 0) AS COHORT_LIFETIME_BV
FROM firsts f
LEFT JOIN person_orders po ON po.PERSON = f.PERSON
GROUP BY f.COHORT_MONTH
ORDER BY f.COHORT_MONTH

WITH first_orders AS (
  SELECT c.CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID,
         MIN(o.ORDER_PURCHASE_TIMESTAMP) AS first_order_date
  FROM ORDERS o
  JOIN CUSTOMERS c ON o.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID
  GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID
),
cohorts AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', fo.first_order_date) AS acquisition_month,
         fo.CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID
  FROM first_orders fo
),
cohort_volume AS (
  SELECT c.acquisition_month,
         COUNT(DISTINCT c.CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID) AS customer_count,
         SUM(oi.PRICE) AS total_lifetime_business_volume
  FROM cohorts c
  JOIN ORDERS o ON EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM first_orders fo 
    WHERE fo.CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID = c.CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID
    AND o.CUSTOMER_ID IN (
      SELECT CUSTOMER_ID FROM CUSTOMERS 
      WHERE CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID = c.CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID
    )
  )
  JOIN ORDER_ITEMS oi ON o.ORDER_ID = oi.ORDER_ID
  WHERE o.ORDER_STATUS = 'delivered'
  GROUP BY c.acquisition_month
)
SELECT acquisition_month,
       customer_count,
       total_lifetime_business_volume
FROM cohort_volume
ORDER BY acquisition_month
